$meta.notes: Buyer-facing strings are written for a non-technical reader on a phone in bright sun: short lines, no jargon, one idea per screen. Feet everywhere; buyers pace land in feet.

welcome.title: Walk the land. Find every corner.
welcome.body: Your phone points you to each corner stake. No app to install, no account.
welcome.loadHint: Best on site. Open this link before you leave pavement so everything loads.

permission.title: Greenways needs your location and compass
permission.body: That's how the arrow points you to each stake. Nothing about you is stored.
permission.iosNote: Your phone will ask twice. Tap Allow both times.
permission.denied: Without location, the arrow can't point. You can still preview the walk.
permission.openSettings: Location is off for this browser. Turn it on in Settings, then come back.

hud.honesty: Stakes mark the exact corner. The arrow gets you within a few steps.
hud.calibrate: Turn slowly in a circle to calibrate the compass.
hud.gpsWeak: Weak GPS. Keep walking — it will settle.
hud.gpsLost: No GPS right now. Step away from trees or vehicles.
hud.courseMode: Walk a few steps so the arrow can point.

picker.title: Pick a corner
picker.subtitle: One at a time. The arrow follows the one you pick.

arrival.title: You found Corner {n}
arrival.subtitle: The stake is within a few steps.

boundary.title: You're just outside the lot line
boundary.body: Head back toward the arrow. The line runs along the fence side.

done.title: You walked all {n} corners
done.body: That's the whole lot, edge to edge. Questions? We're a text away.

preview.title: Preview the walk
preview.body: The whole tour from home: the flyover, the entrance, every corner, the homesite.

offline.noSignal: No signal. Everything you need is already loaded.

sms.walkPack:
Your Greenways walk for {property} is ready: {link}
Open it before you leave pavement so it loads. It points you to every corner stake. — Texas Greener Pastures

help.title: How this works
help.s1: Pick a corner. The arrow points at it and the number is how far in feet.
help.s2: Walk until it says you're there. Look for the stake described on the card.
help.s3: Tap Next corner. The lot line is on the map if you want to see it.
help.s4: If the arrow seems wrong, turn slowly in a circle to reset the compass.

signIn.title: Sign in to Greenways
signIn.body: Team members only. We'll email you a one-tap sign-in link.
signIn.sent: Check your inbox. The link works for 15 minutes.
signIn.notInvited: That email isn't on the team yet. Ask an admin to invite you.

properties.title: Properties
properties.testLotHint: For field-testing the live GPS walk. Corners come from a generated 100 ft square you drop on a map or on your own position — never buyer-facing, and it can never be published.

corners.title: Corners
corners.unlock: Unlock to edit — walk goes offline
corners.order: Numbered clockwise from the road entrance
corners.placeTestSquarePrompt: Click the centre on the map…
corners.testLotNote: Generated 100 ft-radius square for GPS field testing — not CAD-verified geometry, and it can never be published.
corners.noGeolocation: Could not read this device's position. Click the map instead, or allow location access.
corners.lockHint: Locks these exact pins as final — it does not change or reset them. The walk link only serves while corners are locked.

content.title: Buyer-facing text
content.reviewNote: Drafted by AI. Read it before publishing.

media.title: Media
media.realityRule: Approve only what matches the land. Buyers will be standing on it.
media.styleLock: Locked until the intro and entrance are approved (style lock).
media.mockNotice: Media generation is in test mode (no API key configured). Placeholders are labeled MOCK and cost nothing.
media.noCorners: Import the KML first — the corner clips follow the corners.

brief.title: Generation brief
brief.hint: Fills the Prompt Library templates. Blank fields fall back to defaults derived from the record.

publish.title: Publish
publish.blockedEs: Publish is blocked: the Spanish text has not been reviewed by a person (Content tab).
publish.blockedTestLot: A generated test lot can never be published — it exists for GPS testing only.
publish.linkHint: The link goes live the moment the property is published; until then buyers get a not-found page.
publish.prospectHint: Tokenized links tie a walk session to a prospect — issued here or automatically when a Property Tours booking lands (n8n webhook).

demo.title: Demo & QA
demo.body: Runs the real buyer walk with a simulated walker. Same code path as the field.
demo.modeOn: Demo mode on — the walk runs the simulated walker
demo.modeOff: Demo mode off — the walk runs live device GPS
demo.modeHint: With demo mode off this property's link ignores ?demo= entirely and always reads the real phone GPS. Turn it on to run the simulated-walk scenarios below. Real listings stay off.
demo.modeHintTestLot: This is a generated test lot for GPS field testing, so demo mode is normally off: the link reads the real phone GPS. Turn it on only to replay the simulated scenarios on this square.
demo.liveOnly: Live GPS. Open the walk link on the phone you are testing with, allow location and compass, and walk the corners. Stakes mark the exact corner; the arrow gets you within a few steps.
demo.liveWalkBody: The same buyer link, no simulation. Best on the phone itself — a desktop browser has no compass and a coarse position.

scenarios.boundary: Wanders outside the line at Corner 3

team.title: Team
team.inviteHint: Creating an invite emails a sign-in link. Use Resend if it didn't arrive.
